preamble: Natural-light lifestyle photography in a bright airy fitness studio: large windows, soft daylight filling the room, white walls, pale wooden floor, a few plain black kettlebells and dumbbells. High key, gentle contrast, clean fresh grade with true warm skin tones and no colour cast. Shot on 35mm at eye level, shallow depth of field, fine grain. Real people with natural relaxed expressions, plain unbranded athletic wear. Photographic realism, no CGI, no stock-photo gloss, no text, no signs, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: A female personal trainer in her early thirties, athletic build, hair in a ponytail, wearing a plain light-grey fitted t-shirt and plain black leggings, standing relaxed in the bright studio and looking straight at the camera with an open genuine smile, a small white towel over one shoulder. She stands in the right third of the frame, seen from mid-thigh up; the left two thirds of the frame are a plain bright white wall softly lit by window light, completely empty for text. Camera at chest height, 35mm, shallow depth of field, a blurred rack of black dumbbells far behind her on the right. One person only, no mirrors, no text, no signs, no logos on clothes.
